description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different methods for multivariate anomaly detection, measured by the Area Under the Curve (AUC) in percent, as a function of the parameter N, which ranges from 0 to 20 on a linear scale. The y-axis represents AUC (%) and spans from 75% to 100%, with major tick marks at 5% intervals. Five distinct methods are plotted, each represented by a unique combination of color, marker, and line style: a blue line with circle markers starts at approximately 93% AUC at N=0, peaks near 99% at N=5, and declines to about 93% at N=20; an orange line with diamond markers begins at 84% at N=0, rises steadily to 98% at N=10, and then gently decreases to 93% at N=20; a green line with star markers starts at 86% at N=0, increases gradually to 94% at N=15, and ends at 92% at N=20; a red line with square markers begins at 87% at N=0, rises to 99% at N=10, and falls to 91% at N=20; and a purple line with triangle markers remains nearly flat at 79% from N=0 to N=5, then sharply increases to 97% at N=10, before declining to 82% at N=20. A gray square legend marker is present but not associated with any plotted line.
